card.fact_statement: The iPhone 17 Pro includes the new Dual Capture feature for taking video with both cameras simultaneously.
card.source_span: The new Dual Capture feature allows the phone to take video with both the front and rear cameras at the same time.

answer_aliases: ฟีเจอร์ Dual Capture
